QuestInfo.name: Augury Tracking
QuestInfo.0: Ask Marione in Chryse about the Augury.
QuestInfo.1: Marione says that Elder Titan should know about the Augury.
QuestInfo.2: Titan told you that you must find Xerxes to locate the Augury.

0.0: Huh? Who's that? I'm too busy for guests!\r\n#L0##bI shan't take much of your time. Have you heard of the Auguries?#l\n#k
0.1: Auguries? Huh. Yeah, I heard about 'em when I was younger. Why don't you ask the elder about it?

no.0: If that's all, get out of here. I've got too much on my mind...

1.0: What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bI'm told you may know of the Auguries.#l\n#k
1.1: I may know a thing or two. You'll have to excuse the chief--he's got a lot on his plate. As for the Augury, the previous elder passed it down to me.\r\n#L0##bI've come to collect it.#l\n#k
1.2: About that... I don't have it.\r\n#L0##bWhat? Where might I find it?#l\n#k
1.3: Xerxes has it now. You could ask him, but he's not exactly listening to reason these days.

npc.0: Elder Titan is to the left.
